parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the microwave is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that houses all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, shielding, and protection for the internal electronics and cooking chamber.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the microwave is composed of tempered glass with a plastic handle, allowing users to access the cooking chamber.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the entry point to the microwave cavity, providing a seal to contain microwaves and heat during operation.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about a hinge, allowing it to open and close smoothly.
